# Sentinel

> Keyless, read-only Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663) reader for agents and humans. GET-only, block-stamped, never signs or broadcasts.

## API
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://sentinelhood.com/openapi.json): one operation, `GET /api/service?action=network|address|transaction|aeon|contributions|token|launches|shiplog|deployer&value=...`. Share links: `https://sentinelhood.com/?ca=0x...` opens the token check for that address.

## Snapshots
Static JSON, refreshed by a server cron from the official RPC. Each carries the block it was read at.
- [burn.json](https://sentinelhood.com/burn.json): SNTL burned through the token's own burn(), with the latest burns.
- [copies.json](https://sentinelhood.com/copies.json): Pons v2 launches that copy the official SNTL ticker or name.
- [guards.json](https://sentinelhood.com/guards.json): Tokens guarded by a Sentinel Guard burn, and the copies each guard lists.
- [movers.json](https://sentinelhood.com/movers.json): Busiest Pons v2 bonding curves in the last hours, ranked by distinct traders (pons-curve-movers).
- [hook-usage.json](https://sentinelhood.com/hook-usage.json): Pools and swaps per Aeon univ4-hooks hook on Robinhood Chain (hook-usage).
- [registry.json](https://sentinelhood.com/registry.json): Every aeonfun/univ4-hooks address read on its own chain: code present, flag bits (hook-registry-check).
- [token.json](https://sentinelhood.com/token.json): The official Sentinel token, if live; the page only shows it when it has code on chain 4663.

## Aeon skills (Sentinel Pack 1.7.0, 8 skills)
Install all: `bin/install-skill-pack sentinelhood/robinhood-sentinel` from an Aeon checkout. Every skill is read-only, needs no keys and ships `default_enabled: false`.
- [robinhood-chain-monitor](https://sentinelhood.com/skills/robinhood-chain-monitor.md): Watch Robinhood Chain addresses for balance, nonce and bytecode changes - keyless, read-only, block-stamped
- [hook-usage](https://sentinelhood.com/skills/hook-usage.md): Measure real usage of Aeon's Uniswap v4 hooks on Robinhood Chain: pools per hook and recent swaps, keyless from the official RPC
- [pons-launch-watch](https://sentinelhood.com/skills/pons-launch-watch.md): Alert when a new Pons v2 launch on Robinhood Chain copies your token's ticker or name, plus daily launch volume, repeated tickers and busiest deployers - keyless, read-only
- [pons-token-check](https://sentinelhood.com/skills/pons-token-check.md): One-shot check of any Robinhood Chain token: Pons v2 launch record, real trading cost, phase, the deployer's full launch history and holdings - keyless, read-only, block-stamped
- [pons-deployer-watch](https://sentinelhood.com/skills/pons-deployer-watch.md): Alert when a deployer you watch launches a new token on Pons v2 (Robinhood Chain), plus the busiest deployers of the day - watch by deployer or by any token they made, keyless, read-only
- [pons-graduation-watch](https://sentinelhood.com/skills/pons-graduation-watch.md): Alert when a Pons v2 token on Robinhood Chain graduates from its bonding curve to a locked Uniswap v4 pool, with the amount moved into the pool and the day's graduation rate - all tokens or only ones you watch, keyless, read-only
- [pons-curve-movers](https://sentinelhood.com/skills/pons-curve-movers.md): The most active Pons v2 bonding curves on Robinhood Chain in the last few hours - buys, sells, distinct traders, volume, net flow and progress toward graduation, for tokens DEX scanners cannot see yet - keyless, read-only
- [hook-registry-check](https://sentinelhood.com/skills/hook-registry-check.md): Check every address in Aeon's public Uniswap v4 hook registry against its chain - code present, flag bits match the address, same functions on every chain - and report only what changed, keyless, read-only

## Limits
- Read-only: no signing, no broadcasting, no keys.
- Historical reads, not pre-sign simulation. No result is a safety guarantee or a buy/sell signal.
- Counts are of addresses and events, not people: routers and one person with many wallets both distort them.
